answer: A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 51 aliases trips the duplicate check at the sparrow gate. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a ledge seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The willow receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Honest users pay that once, farms 19 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
